personality_one_liner: Precision municipal AI vision and complaint tracking with iOS-native clarity, confidence scores, and instant role switching.

spacing.rule: Maintain comfortable iOS vertical rhythm with generous card padding and touch targets >= 44pt

do's: Use frosted glass header and tab bar over scrolling content
Apply translucent tinted base over overlays
dont's: Never blur body text or form inputs
Avoid heavy blur on dense operational lists

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Login, register, and one-tap demo account switcher for User, Authority, and Admin roles.

states.error: Invalid credentials or network error. Please retry.

screens.layout: Centered clean card with professional civic-tech branding, role selection pills, and instant demo login buttons.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Central hub showing active complaints, status metrics, and quick action to inspect road damage.

states.empty: No recent complaints or reports found. Tap below to start an inspection.
states.error: Failed to sync municipal data. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Scrollable feed with top summary metrics cards (Total, In Progress, Resolved), active repair alerts, and sticky bottom primary inspection CTA.

screens.name: New Inspection
screens.purpose: Camera/Gallery capture with real-time GPS metadata extraction and AI road-damage scanning.

states.loading: Analyzing road damage with GPT-5.4 Vision...
states.empty: Capture or select a road image to begin AI analysis.
states.error: AI vision analysis timed out. Please check connection and retry.

screens.layout: Camera viewfinder UI with bounding box overlay preview, GPS badge, severity toggle, and instant 'Run AI Analysis' trigger.

screens.name: AI Analysis Result
screens.purpose: Detailed breakdown of detected damage including type, confidence score, severity rating (Low/Medium/High), and bounding coordinates.

states.loading: Synthesizing bounding boxes and severity metrics...

screens.layout: Card stack showing annotated image with bounding box, severity badge (Red/Orange/Green), confidence meter, and 'Submit Complaint' sticky button.

screens.name: Complaint Tracker
screens.purpose: Track lifecycle status across SUBMITTED, ASSIGNED, ACKNOWLEDGED, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED, and CLOSED stages.
screens.layout: Vertical milestone timeline with status pills, authority contact details, timestamp logs, and live status badges.

screens.name: Authority Workspace
screens.purpose: Assigned complaints management for municipal field workers to acknowledge, start work, upload proof-of-fix images, and resolve.

states.empty: All caught up! No pending municipal work orders assigned.
states.error: Failed to load authority dispatch queue.

screens.layout: List of assigned municipal tickets with action buttons (Acknowledge, Start Work, Upload Repair Photo, Resolve).

screens.name: Admin Governance
screens.purpose: System-wide governance for managing users, demo authorities, dispatching complaints, and viewing municipal heatmaps.
screens.layout: Tabbed admin view containing user list, authority dispatcher dropdowns, system stats, and audit logs.

screens.name: Notification Center
screens.purpose: Real-time in-app alerts on status changes, repair completions, and dispatch updates.
screens.layout: Chronological list of unread and read civic alerts with severity accent bars and timestamp pills.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build RoadLens mobile MVP strictly adhering to iOS-Native Clean styling with navy/white/gray civic palette. Implement GPT-5.4 Vision via Emergent Universal Key simulation for instant pothole/crack detection with bounding boxes and severity (Red=High, Orange=Medium, Green=Low). Include a One-tap Demo Account Switcher for USER, AUTHORITY, and ADMIN roles in the auth and header banner. Provide fully functional lifecycle tracking (SUBMITTED, ASSIGNED, ACKNOWLEDGED, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED, CLOSED) and authority repair proof upload.
